newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans fall on demand ideas, weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans fall on demand ideas, weather.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures fell in late trade amid ideas demand for old crop supplies was tapering off, traders said.

Floor sources pointed to indications soybean crushing rates would slip in the coming weeks as processors took seasonal downtime. Export demand was also said to be weakening after a spurt of activity in early July.
New crop months struggled with weather forecasts predicting widespread rains next week for central Illinois.
At 1240 CDT, soybeans were down 9-1/2 to seven cents per bushel with November down 9-1/2 at $5.99-1/2.
